en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Dawood Bin Al Qasim Al Ja’fary who said,

‘I went over to Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> and with me were three papers without an address (of the sender) and it was doubtful upon me. So I was gloomy, and he<sup>asws</sup> took one of them and said: ‘This paper is of Ziyad Bin Shuayb’. Then he<sup>asws</sup> took the second and he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘This paper is of so and so’. So I was amazed, and he<sup>asws</sup> looked at me and he<sup>asws</sup> smiled.

He (the narrator) said, ‘And he<sup>asws</sup> gave me three hundred Dinars and instructed me that I should carry these to one of the sons of his<sup>asws</sup> uncle and said: ‘However, he would be saying to you, ‘Point me to a trader to buy some provisions for me with it’. So point him out for him’. 
He (the narrator) said, ‘So I went over to him with the Dinars, and he said to me, ‘O Abu Hashim! Point me to a trader to buy some provisions for me with it’. So I said, ‘Yes’.

He (the narrator) said, ‘And a camelier spoke to me that I should speak to him<sup>asws</sup> for him to include him into one of his<sup>asws</sup> matters. So I went over to him<sup>asws</sup> in order to speak to him<sup>asws</sup>, and I found him<sup>asws</sup> to be eating and with him<sup>asws</sup> was a group, and I was not able to speak to him<sup>asws</sup>. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Abu Hashim, Eat!’ And (the meal) was placed in front of me. Then he<sup>asws</sup> said initiating from him<sup>asws</sup>, from without being asked: ‘O boy! Look after the camelier from whom Abu Hashim has come, so embrace him to you’.

He (the narrator) said, ‘And I went over to the Orchard with him<sup>asws</sup> one day, so I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! I am addictively fond of eating figs, so supplicate for me’. So he<sup>asws</sup> was silent. Then he<sup>asws</sup> said to me after three days, initiating from him<sup>asws</sup>: ‘O Abu Hashim! Allah<sup>azwj</sup> has Removed from you the eating of the figs’. Abu Hashim said, ‘So there is nothing more hateful to me than it (eating figs) today’.
